target.title: fix(release): reconcile contribution provenance
target.body:
Closes #103429

> Draft/HOLD: do not merge until the immutable historical reconciliation and
> final release-candidate replay are attached.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where release maintainers could generate an incomplete
contribution record because the verifier treated first-parent history as the
source inventory and allowed contextual references to stand in for source-PR
ownership.

## Why This Change Was Made

The verifier now inventories the complete raw Git DAG from the unique merge
base, rejects shallow/grafted/replaced history, and assigns each commit through
auditable GitHub associations, strict merged-PR directives, exact/partial/
adapted provenance, verified revert parity, or direct-commit classification.
It also records canonical/current/generated/missing/stale sets, compares the
canonical inventory with the complete merged-main GitHub universe, and accepts
only a bounded association-free `CHANGELOG.md` tail after the immutable product
cutoff.

## User Impact

Release maintainers get a deterministic, fail-closed contribution manifest with
complete source-PR credit, direct-commit auditability, explicit
shipped/reverted exclusions, immutable evidence hashes, and concrete
reconciliation metrics before publication.

## Evidence

- Frozen head: `4e740da2b89dffa6e50e6f33d3167d2213300546`, rebased on
  `1439646f197067441bdfbdffb7810f81e95ce7cf`; the changed-file tree hash was
  identical before and after rebase.
- Blacksmith Testbox run
  `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29099267119`, box
  `tbx_01kx668gcb6j9a9bshc0g0j2zq`, Node `24.13.0`:
  - focused ledger, GitHub inventory, source inventory, and verifier suites:
    55/55 passed;
  - final snapshot-OID contract delta: 6/6 passed;
  - scoped `pnpm check:changed`: all guards, full `tsgo`, core/extensions/
    scripts oxlint, and runtime import-cycle checks passed.
- The only change after the full focused/scoped proof was an invariant comment
  plus its GitHub snapshot-OID regression test; product/runtime behavior was
  unchanged and the affected exact-byte test was rerun.
- Fresh structured autoreview: no findings; patch correct, confidence `0.82`.
- Historical fixture model:
  `306b800ace5398dcfc5eae6e15dcae533db42c95` product cutoff to
  `811ddd96180583bae00001f71971419182ae0520` final target, maximum two
  `CHANGELOG.md`-only tail commits. Expected reconciliation:
  `2389 - 421 post-fork - 6 shipped/boundary - 2 reverted = 1960`, with zero
  unclassified PRs. Immutable replay is pending against this frozen PR head.

AI-assisted implementation and review.
